properties.name: Kinmen Airport (Shangyi)
properties.note: Single-runway civil airport sharing its site with the ROC Air Force.

properties.name: Shuitou Pier
properties.note: Ferry terminal: routes to Xiamen (Wutong, Dongdu), Quanzhou and Lieyu.

properties.name: Kinmen Bridge
properties.note: About 5 km, Greater Kinmen to Lieyu; opened 30 October 2022.

properties.name: Dadan Island
properties.note: About 4.4 km from Xiamen. Handed to county control in 2014; sources differ on the current troop presence.

properties.name: Erdan Island
properties.note: Troops stationed; no residents. Site of 2022 drone incidents.

properties.name: Wutong Ferry Terminal
properties.note: Xiamen terminal with hourly ferries to Kinmen.

properties.name: Xiamen Gaoqi Airport
properties.note: Due to end civil operations when Xiang'an airport opens (24 Dec 2026, per Wikipedia).

properties.name: Nangan Airport
properties.note: Public airport on Nangan with turboprop flights to Taiwan.

properties.name: Beigan Airport
properties.note: Public airport on Beigan; flights to Taipei Songshan.

properties.name: Dongyin
properties.note: Northernmost Matsu island, about 19 km from the mainland. Soldiers outnumber residents several times; missile deployment reported in 2001.

properties.name: Penghu Airport (Magong)
properties.note: Domestic airport owned by the ROC Air Force; Magong Air Base shares the site.

properties.name: Magong Harbor
properties.note: Main harbour: 9 docks, ferries to Kaohsiung, Tainan and Chiayi; cruise pier added 2015.

properties.name: Penghu Great Bridge
properties.note: 2.5 km bridge linking Baisha and Siyu islands; current deck opened 1996.

properties.name: Qimei Airport
properties.note: Small public airport on Qimei, Penghu's southernmost inhabited island.

properties.name: Fuzhou Changle Airport
properties.note: Fuzhou's international airport, about 50 km east of the city; 16.1 million passengers in 2025.

properties.name: Quanzhou Jinjiang Airport
properties.note: Shared military and civilian airport serving Quanzhou; a XiamenAir focus base.

properties.name: Pingtan Island
properties.note: Bridged to the mainland in 2010 and by a road-rail bridge with a high-speed station (2020); Haixia ferries run from Aoqian Wharf to Taichung and Kaohsiung.

properties.name: Huangqi
properties.note: Town on the Huangqi peninsula; the Huangqi–Matsu ferry (from December 2015) is the shortest mainland–Matsu crossing.

properties.name: Port of Fuzhou
properties.note: Fujian's capital port; deep-water areas at Jiangyin and Luoyuan Bay.
